div.head: Wer 6
div.ab: Of ðam dæge, þe þæt healsfang agolden sy, on XXI nihtan gylde man ða manbote; ðæs on XXI nihtan þæt fyht[e]wite; ðæs on XXI nihtan ðæs weres þæt frumgyld; 7 swa forð, þæt fulgolden sy on ðam fyrste, ðe witan geræddan.

A die illa qua healsfangum redditum sit, in XXI. noctem reddatur manbota; inde in XXI. noctem fihtƿita (id est forisfactura pugne); inde ad XXI. noctem ipsius were frumgildum (id est prima redditio); et sic postea, donec persoluatur infra terminum, quem sapientes instituent.

Of ðam dæge, ðe ðæt healsfang agolden sy, on XXI nihtan gylde man ða manbote; ðæs on XXI nihtan ðæt fyhtewite; ðæs on XXI nihtan ðæs weres ðæt frumgyld; 7 swa forð, ðæt fulgolden sy on ðam fyrste, ðe witan geræden.

Von dém Tage, da das Halsfanggeld entrichtet ist, in 21 Tagen zahle man [dem Herrn des Erschlagenen] Busse für Erschlagung des Untergebenen; von dem ab in 21 Tagen die Strafe für Blutvergiessen [an die Obrigkeit]; von dem ab in 21 Tagen die Erstzahlung des Wergeldes [an die Sippe]; und so weiter, damit [es] vollbezahlt sei in der Frist, welche die notablen Schiedsmannen bestimmen (-mt haben B).

Within 21 days from the day the healsfang is paid, let one pay [to the slain man's lord] the compensation for killing his man; within 21 days from then the fine for fighting [to the authorities]; within 21 days from then the first payment of the wergild [to the kin]; and so on, so that [it] is fully paid within the term which the notable arbitrators determine (have determined, B).

From the day when healsfang is to be paid, within twenty-one days, manbot is to be paid; then within twenty-one days the fighting-fine; then within twenty-one days the first instalment of the wergeld; and so on, until full payment is made within the time-limit that the witan have ordained.
